INTAKE.title: Intake
INTAKE.reminder: Intake only — no code. Write the requirement summary into context-map.md.
INTAKE.playbook:
## Phase 0 · INTAKE
Goal: pin down WHAT to build as a short requirement summary. **Do not touch code yet.**

1. If a prototype/PRD link is given: fetch it **once** with the browser MCP; if your project ships a PRD-extraction skill, reuse it instead of re-parsing.
2. Write the summary (goal / surfaces involved / acceptance points / obvious constraints) with `loop_record context-map`.
3. Then call `loop_advance CLARIFY`.

Guardrails: fetch <=2 times; do not start exploring code; write the summary to disk, not into the conversation.

CLARIFY.title: Clarify
CLARIFY.reminder: Merge all open questions into ONE ask; append answers to context-map.md.
CLARIFY.playbook:
## Phase 1 · CLARIFY
Goal: remove ambiguity before acting.

1. List the questions that would change the implementation (scope / boundaries / change-everywhere? / trade-offs) and ask them **in one combined message** — no back-and-forth.
2. After the answers, append a '## Clarifications' block with `loop_record context-map` (append).
3. Call `loop_advance CLARIFY->INVESTIGATE`, stating the conclusion in evidence (or `no-questions`).

Guardrail: no clarification conclusion and empty evidence -> not allowed to enter INVESTIGATE.

INVESTIGATE.title: Investigate
INVESTIGATE.reminder: Locate before reading; never re-read a mapped file; write findings into context-map.md.
INVESTIGATE.playbook:
## Phase 2 · INVESTIGATE (the key token-saving phase)
Goal: map every change point with the least exploration and **write it to context-map.md**.

Discipline (G1-G3):
- **Locate** with Grep/Glob/semantic search first, then read by **line range** — never whole files.
- Read each file **once**: write key signatures / call chains / line numbers into context-map immediately; afterwards consult context-map, do not re-read.
- **Batch** related searches; fire independent calls **in parallel** in one turn.
- Usage counting: clients with the budget hook count **automatically** (Claude Code counts even searches; Cursor only file reads); for searches that aren't auto-counted (e.g. Cursor native grep) report manually with `loop_budget grep 1`.

context-map must contain at least: involved files `path:line`, key function signatures, call chains, **reusable existing helpers/methods**, and a 'change-point coverage checklist'.

When done, `loop_advance INVESTIGATE->PLAN`. Hitting the budget triggers a warning (80%) telling you to wrap up — that means stop scattering reads, not continue.

PLAN.title: Plan
PLAN.reminder: Write plan.md; only user approval (evidence:'user-approved') unlocks IMPLEMENT.
PLAN.playbook:
## Phase 3 · PLAN
Goal: produce an executable, skimmable plan.md and get user approval.

1. `loop_record plan` with: background / approach / **change list (per file: what + why)** / verification steps.
2. Prefer **reusing** the existing helpers/methods recorded in context-map, citing their paths; keep changes surgical and minimal.
3. Get user confirmation. Once approved, `loop_advance PLAN->IMPLEMENT` with `evidence: 'user-approved'`.

Guardrail: plan.md not written or not approved -> not allowed to enter IMPLEMENT.

IMPLEMENT.title: Implement
IMPLEMENT.reminder: Small/none -> finish in this session; substantial -> continue in a clean context (/clear then /loop, or a subagent); precise edits; update progress.md each step.
IMPLEMENT.playbook:
## Phase 4 · IMPLEMENT
Goal: land the plan without blowing up the context.

✅ State is saved. **Look at the plan's change list first:**
- **Empty / tiny (no real code change, e.g. already exists)**: finish IMPLEMENT->VERIFY in **this session**; no /clear or subagent needed.
- **Substantial multi-step change**: continue in a **clean context** (without the long INVESTIGATE conversation) —
  - Universal: `/clear` then run `/loop` (no args) -> the engine `loop_resume` inlines plan + context-map and continues.
  - Claude Code can also dispatch a subagent from the main session directly (no /clear).
  - Clients without slash commands: call `loop_resume` in a new chat.

Discipline:
- Use **precise StrReplace**, not whole-file Write (whole-file dumps the entire text into context and pins it forever).
- One logical change at a time; tick it off with `loop_record progress` (append) after each step.
- Change only what the plan says; clean up orphan imports/vars you create; do not refactor unrelated code.

When all done, `loop_advance IMPLEMENT->VERIFY`.

VERIFY.title: Verify
VERIFY.reminder: Run the verify command; record command + output into progress.md; on failure go back to IMPLEMENT.
VERIFY.playbook:
## Phase 5 · VERIFY
Goal: prove the change works with evidence.

1. **Scope self-check**: confirm the actually-changed files (`git diff --stat`) all fall within plan.md's change list; explain or revert extras.
2. Run the verify command (see profile's verify). When the change touches **multiple surfaces / shared logic**, verify each affected surface — don't compile just one module.
3. Record **command + key output** with `loop_record progress` (append).
4. Pass -> `loop_advance VERIFY->DONE` (evidence `passed: <cmd>`; negatives like fail/not-passed are rejected). Fail -> `loop_advance VERIFY->IMPLEMENT` to fix.

Guardrail: no passing evidence -> not allowed into DONE; evidence containing a negation is rejected.

DONE.title: Done
DONE.playbook:
## ✅ DONE
This loop is finished. `.agent-loop/<task>/` keeps context-map / plan / progress as a traceable record.
For wrap-up (merge branch / open PR), continue with your usual flow.

gates.done-terminal: loop already finished (DONE). Start a new task with loop_start to rework.
gates.no-skip: cannot skip phases: currently {from}, you may only enter the next phase {next}.
gates.INTAKE: Write the requirement summary into context-map with loop_record context-map first (>=40 chars).
gates.CLARIFY: State the clarification conclusion in evidence (>=12 chars, or include 'no-questions'), or record it into context-map first.
gates.INVESTIGATE: context-map has too few findings (need >=200 chars); add involved files/signatures/call-chains/reusables and the coverage checklist.
gates.plan-missing: Write the plan with loop_record plan first.
gates.plan-unapproved: plan.md is ready. Confirm with the user, then call loop_advance with evidence:'user-approved'.
gates.IMPLEMENT: Write implementation progress into progress.md first (loop_record progress).
gates.VERIFY: No passing evidence. Record the verify command + output into progress, and state 'passed: <cmd>' in evidence (negations like fail are rejected). To go back, use loop_advance VERIFY->IMPLEMENT.

tools.loop_start: Start a new development loop (or resume a same-named task). Initializes .agent-loop/<task>/ and state, returns the current phase's playbook. Call once at the start of each requirement/task.
tools.loop_status: Return the current loop's phase, budget usage, artifact list and next action. Read-only, callable anytime.
tools.loop_record: Write working memory to disk artifacts (context-map / plan / progress) instead of piling it into the conversation — the core token saver. Appends by default.
tools.loop_budget: Report one tool's usage (for the INVESTIGATE exploration budget). E.g. loop_budget read 3. Over-budget warns in status/advance.
tools.loop_advance: Request entering a target phase. The engine checks the gate (e.g. an unapproved plan can't enter IMPLEMENT); on pass it serves the next phase's playbook just-in-time. Backward moves (e.g. VERIFY->IMPLEMENT) are always allowed.
tools.loop_resume: Resume the active loop: load state from .active and inline the approved plan + context-map together with the current phase playbook — used to continue in a clean context after /clear or a subagent. Read-only; does not advance. No args.

ui.start.toolsLine: — Tools: loop_status (state) · loop_record (write artifacts) · loop_budget (report usage) · loop_advance (next phase).
ui.status.title: # Agent Loop · {task}
ui.budget.noLimit: Recorded {tool}={used} (no budget ceiling for this tool).
ui.budget.over: Recorded {tool}={used}/{limit} — over budget; stop scattering reads, write findings into context-map then loop_advance PLAN.
ui.budget.near: Recorded {tool}={used}/{limit} ⚠️ budget nearly full, wrap up.
ui.noActive: No active loop. Call loop_start first.
ui.noActiveResume: No resumable loop (projectRoot={root}, .active does not point to a valid state). Call loop_start first.
